WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS ws_sales_price
    FROM filtered_dates fd
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
store_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS ss_sales_price
    FROM filtered_dates fd
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(ws_sales_price) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_daily
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(ss_sales_price) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_daily
),
combined AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT COALESCE(web.item_sk, store.item_sk) AS item_sk,
           COALESCE(web.d_date, store.d_date) AS d_date,
           web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1 web
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 store
      ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date
),
filtered_cumulative AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) FILTER (WHERE web_sales IS NOT NULL) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) FILTER (WHERE store_sales IS NOT NULL) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined
),
pruned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, web_cumulative, store_cumulative
    FROM filtered_cumulative
    WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
)
SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, web_cumulative, store_cumulative
FROM pruned
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
